en.basel-kadem: 1.	We were informed by al-Hakim, Abu Hamid, Ahmad bin Hussain bin Ali, in Balkh, that he said: We were told by Muhammed bin Abbas, that he said: We were told by Ibrahim bin Ishaq, that he said: I was told by Ibrahim bin Sa’eed, that he said: We were told by Abu Na’eem, that he said: We were told by Isam bin Qudama, from Ikrima, from Ibn Abbas, from the Prophet, Allah’s blessings be upon him and his Family,

that he said to his women: I wish I knew which one of you is going to be one with the camel that is adbab to whom the dogs of Haw’ab, and then, it will be killed, by her right and by her left, many victims, and then she will be saved after she is near.
